description: List Google Search Console properties for the user's locally authorized Google account. Requires prior setup with `edgeo-mcp search-console connect`; uses a read-only OAuth scope and returns only properties the Google account can access. Optionally filter property URLs by a case-insensitive substring.

siteUrlContains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter property URLs.

name: edgeo_search_console_sites
title: List connected Search Console properties
